title: Drone Strike Hits Al-Sayyah Market, North Darfur, Killing One
detail: A drone strike, alleged to be conducted by the Sudanese Armed Forces, hit the main market in Al-Sayyah town, North Darfur, on June 22, 2026, while RSF vehicles were reportedly nearby. The strike killed resident Adam Haroun Bakrin and injured several others; four successive missile strikes set the southern market section ablaze, destroying goods worth an estimated 100 million SDG and causing roughly 50 million SDG in infrastructure damage. Al-Sayyah is a major weekly trading hub serving Al-Malha, Al-Kuma, Malit, and surrounding North Darfur communities.

title: Rival Faction Seizes Kauda, SPLM-N (al-Hilu) Stronghold in Nuba Mountains
detail: A rival armed faction drawn from the Otoro ethnic group seized large parts of Kauda, the main stronghold of Abdel Aziz al-Hilu's SPLM-N faction in South Kordofan, on June 22, 2026, following a Shawaya-Otoro tribal border dispute that al-Hilu's leadership had approved but Otoro leaders rejected. The dissident group expelled the local SPLM-N administration and burned the homes of officials, including SPLM-N Secretary Amar Amum Daldoum and the Alternate Governor of the Nuba Mountains; churches and aid-organization offices were also damaged. South Sudanese-led mediation efforts to resolve the dispute failed. The internal fracture within SPLM-N (al-Hilu) — one of the RSF's Kordofan-front allies — marks a significant complication for the RSF-SPLM-N alliance in the Nuba Mountains theater.
